description: Most recently updated tenders from Ukraine's ProZorro national procurement system (via the keyless OpenProcurement public feed). Returns each tender with id, tenderID, title, value (amount+currency, usually UAH), buyer (procuring entity), status, and procurement method. Titles and buyer names are in Ukrainian. Use for browsing current Ukrainian public tenders; for a specific tender use prozorro_get_tender.

limit.description: How many recent tenders to return (1-50). Default 20.

name: prozorro_recent_tenders
title: Prozorro Recent Tenders
